dataset: MIT Interview Dataset, 138 videos from 69 participants

pilot.selection: first three available participant IDs; convenience engineering check
pilot.finding: all measurable pilot heads triggered frozen camera-relative classifier

full_extraction.reason: sustained-event transfer and compute budget; different sampling from pilot
full_extraction.source_checks: archive CRC, source and model SHA-256; no MIT label fitting

relative_events.gaze_reference: normalized component-wise median gaze vector while head is near its baseline
relative_events.eye_gate: one face, acceptable image quality, relative head below threshold
relative_events.missing_calibration: abstain; do not fill baseline using future evaluation frames

columbia_calibration_checks.one_point: 0V/0H image per person for baseline; exclude it from all scores
columbia_calibration_checks.five_point: known center, +/-15H and +/-10V targets; exclude all five for every comparator
columbia_calibration_checks.report: same-cohort comparisons; 1000 participant-bootstrap replicates with seed 20261029
columbia_calibration_checks.scope: direction labels, no interview AI-use inference

unavailable_metrics: event false-positive rate without manual annotations
privacy: raw media and per-recording outputs stay in ignored local data paths
